name: Butterfly Palms
summary: Trains both sides of the body to attack, defend, and move together. When splitting actions, restore one die to one reduced dice pool.
citation: Tradition Book: Akashic Brotherhood, Revised, p. 64

name: Weapon Art
summary: Applies Do training to a familiar melee weapon. Compatible Do benefits may apply, but the attack pool remains limited by Do.
citation: Tradition Book: Akashic Brotherhood, Revised, p. 64

name: Peaceful Way
summary: Applies Do's discipline to one Ability associated with the Eight Limbs, granting Do's reduced-difficulty benefit.
citation: Tradition Book: Akashic Brotherhood, Revised, p. 64

name: Arrow Cutting
summary: Deflects arrows and similar missiles. A harder use catches the missile for later use. It does not normally work against bullets.
citation: Tradition Book: Akashic Brotherhood, Revised, p. 64

name: Broken Rhythm
summary: Uses irregular timing to disrupt an opponent's defense. The attack is harder, but the defender may suffer a penalty.
citation: Tradition Book: Akashic Brotherhood, Revised, p. 64–65

name: Iron Shirt
summary: Adds the character's Do rating to soak rolls against bashing damage, subject to the maneuver's limits.
citation: Tradition Book: Akashic Brotherhood, Revised, p. 65

name: Iron Hand
summary: Conditions the hands to break objects and penetrate defenses. The target loses one soak die, but fine touch is impaired.
citation: Tradition Book: Akashic Brotherhood, Revised, p. 65

name: Kiaijutsu
summary: Uses a shout or controlled voice to frighten, disrupt, command, or intimidate.
citation: Tradition Book: Akashic Brotherhood, Revised, p. 65

name: Jou Chuan — Soft Fist
summary: Redirects an incoming unarmed or melee attack into the attacker or another nearby opponent.
citation: Tradition Book: Akashic Brotherhood, Revised, p. 65–66

name: Escape Arts
summary: Uses flexibility and controlled dislocation to escape restraints. More secure restraints require a roll.
citation: Tradition Book: Akashic Brotherhood, Revised, p. 66

name: Plum Flower Blossom
summary: Improves balance, jumping, rebounding, acrobatics, and leaping attacks.
citation: Tradition Book: Akashic Brotherhood, Revised, p. 66

name: Ten Thousand Weapons
summary: Allows almost any handheld, thrown, or spat object to function as a weapon.
citation: Tradition Book: Akashic Brotherhood, Revised, p. 66

name: Dim Mak
summary: A pressure-point attack that can delay damage and may temporarily reduce a Physical Attribute.

name: Kongjin — Empty Force
summary: Projects force through chi so a strike can land without direct contact.

name: San He
summary: Coordinates body, mind, and spirit to channel internal force into exceptional physical performance.
